entry.title: New: Bill 111 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 3.100, MAUI COUNTY CODE, RELATING TO GENERAL EXCISE AND USE TAX SURCHARGE" The purpose of this bill is to allocate 80 percent of all funds received from the general excise tax and use surcharge to the general excise tax fund; 2) establish a new Section 3.100.021 entitled "General excise tax fund - Department of Hawaiian Home Lands" and allocating 20 percent of all funds received from the general excise tax and use surcharge; and 3) amend Section 3.100.040, Maui County Code to delete Subsection (C), and add the general excise tax fund - Department of Hawaiian Home Lands to the final section.
